title: Teaching Jonah Jones to regain his lip
summary: Jonah Jones, with new dental caps, cannot play; Maxwell's embouchure system restores his high register in ten days.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I have 20 pupils so I have a good foundation with that. And they're getting better, thanks to people like Clark Terry and Jonah Jones, Doc Sevrinson. They send people to me all the time so I'm getting better pupils and whatnot. In fact, Jonah took some lessons from me, did you know that?
No, but I know you'd be good for him.

He gave me the most beautiful article in the Boston Globe, it was a half-page article. He had his teeth capped and he lost his lip. He couldn't make a single sound. I had worked out a system for things like that, or I had a guy shot up in the Korean War, how they can rediscover embouchure and build up a high register and everything. So I went -- I heard him practicing and he was just going (PANTING) for hours. And I asked him what happened and he showed me these big caps. And he used to have little stubby teeth and he couldn't get a sound. And he said, "I've got to open up at the Playboy Club in 10 days." So I said, "Well, I think I can help you if you want to work everyday."
And I thought, why the hell did I say that? I don't know. But I got in two or three hours everyday. And now here, I'm handling one of my idols, you know. And how are you going

to tell -- you sit there with a man you respect. And, you know, when he wanted to pay me I said, "Man, you've already paid me." He said, "What do you mean?" I said, "I practically made a career off Jonah Joins the Cab". I said, "half the things I play comes off your record, "Jonah Joins with Cab." I said, "You've paid me 1,000 times over." But he insisted on paying me. So by the end of ten days he had his lip back, he's playing up to high F. And he was in tears, you know. He said, "There are two people I love, I love Jesus Christ and Jim Maxwell and I don't know if that's the right order." And he gave this beautiful write-up to the Boston paper and told how I'd helped him.

Now, Buck Clayton had some trouble and he literally dragged him down to my studio and I gave Buck five or six lessons. And he wrote me a nice letter from Egypt and said it was just great. So I'm getting people like that.
